common_bolus: Current announced meal grams / published patient CR * bolus_factor; no correction bolus; identical across methods
policy_information: Original history-only baselines receive72x22 observable history. Our reference/residual group and matched architecture controls additionally receive one fixed scalar computed only from the earliest available72 observed prior-5min basal amounts. No policy receives future events, true BG or private patient states. The same common meal bolus module and nominal-reference advantage from v1 remain explicit.
failure_accounting: Fixed denominator after warmup. BG>600/nonfinite terminates with remaining BG=600; BG<10 with BG=10. Any termination reported, not discarded.
primary_metric: Patient-equally-weighted TIR 70-180 mg/dL, averaged over paired scenario seeds and all bolus factors
interpretation: Research thresholds chosen for this experiment, not clinical standards; one-sided descriptive tolerance. Report exact differences and cluster CI including failure. No claim of superiority unless estimates support it. Does not approve clinical or product deployment.
checkpoint_selection: Dev only: remove terminal-failure candidates if any nonfailed alternatives; prefer satisfying relative low-glucose tolerances then highest patient-mean TIR. If none satisfy, report failure and investigate without changing frozen test thresholds.
comparison_training: Loop-only zero-shot transfer first. Any additional simulation training uses separate rows and equal data/budget for all RL methods.
ci: Paired patient cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples seed 9981. Average scenarios and training seeds within patient first. Also show each training seed and worst patient.

observed_reference.training: Each patient first eligible72-row history; mean of raw previous5min basal interval U x12; source rows<=first eligible decision. No original targets or origins removed.
observed_reference.simulation: Computed once at first learned decision after common6h warmup from72 observed delivered basal intervals, then held fixed for that3-day scenario. New policy instance for every patient/scenario.
observed_reference.input_dimensions: 1584 flattened history +1 normalized fixed reference, total1585
observed_reference.limitation: Observed historical delivery is not a clinically verified basal requirement. No proof of validity after the evaluated3-day scenario or under major requirement shifts.

policy_output.bounded_residual: clip(reference+L*tanh(2*f/L),0,20); L explicitly supplied in trained config
policy_output.pump_units_and_delivery: Same official pump U/min conversion and rounding as v1, all requested and delivered actions logged

training_seed_scope.reason: Explicit latest user instruction: one external baseline training seed; focus resources on our model. Original performance tolerances remain.

stage_interpretation: This amendment declares information/architecture adaptations already registered before their pilot runs in research protocol21:04/21:22. It is created after exploratory development results and before any sealed patient evaluation; it does not turn reused dev results into sealed evidence.
